svg.aria-label: The revision mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Peer reviewer: the comments as a revision roadmap (agent); Script: anchorize the draft (script); Draft writer: a patch, never a full draft (agent); Script: apply the patch to a new file (script); You decide: retry, full re-emission or abort (stop); You acknowledge it, or the patch is narrowed (stop); You confirm a full re-emission (stop); Citation compliance on the revised draft (agent); Revised draft, apply report, revision log (agent) | paper, as ruled: Intake: config.md, the run's permissions, DOI checking, the instructions [D24, Stops of paper, O, AA], the claims not to make [AI2], a file given in words [AQ], the evidence profile [AV2] (stop); Peer reviewer: the instructions as items.md (agent); Peer reviewer: reviews the manuscript with full mode's draft-review criteria, its issues as items.md [AA] (ruled); You approve the items: drop or add, no patch before [AA] (stop); Literature strategist: a .bib patch [Stops of paper] (ruled); Visualization, within the permission; the script files it changes outside the run folder are hashed before and after [Stops of paper] (ruled); Script: anchorize the files (script); Draft writer: a patch per item, a revision log with its statuses [AD6] (ruled); Script: apply the patch (script); A patch that does not apply (stop); A structural patch (stop); Citation compliance agent, after the patches: reads each cited source, checks the claims not to make, lists the claims off the list of intended claims [AF, AI2, AV7] (ruled); A claim the run cannot support [AF] (stop); The citation style to confirm: more than half the entries fail the same check [AV14] (stop); Script: cite-keys, check-urls, quote-check, failures are items of reading 1 [D49, K, AF] (ruled); Citation compliance agent again, fresh, once [AF] (ruled); Peer reviewer: reading 1, reads the citation report [D49, AF] (ruled); Draft writer: the one pass [D49] (ruled); Script: reference checks, failures are items of reading 2 [K] (ruled); Peer reviewer: reading 2 [D49] (ruled); Draft writer: reference-fix, once [K] (ruled); Script: reference checks again, failures left named [K] (script); A reference that cannot be confirmed [O] (stop); Session: compile in a copy; the engine is the first that applies of a % !TEX program line, the class table, the venue's template, XeLaTeX [D46, AV11] [4.A R2-6] (ruled); Draft writer: compile-fix, once [M] (ruled); Session: compile once more, the rest named [M] (ruled); /writing review: 4 agents [D46] (ruled); End: the final message with the numbered report, the sources only a preprint server or no index matched, and the files the figure script changed [D46, AG] (ruled); Draft writer: applies the findings, then the compile again [D46] (ruled); Draft writer: the anonymous copy, when the venue is double-blind [AV9] (ruled); At every patch: a script failed (stop); At every agent start: a model other than the configured one [D47] (stop).

svg.text: academic-paper: no compile and no formatter in this mode. Its agents are the peer reviewer, the draft writer and citation compliance; the mode table lists no intake agent for it, while the intake page's mode list names it. paper: "The stops of paper" is a ruling of plan 5. paper has no full re-emission: a structural patch is acknowledged or narrowed once
